channel.title: Use ClockVM instead of sdwdate
channel.description: As I understand (correct me if I'm wrong) Kicksecure doesn't use ClockVM to synchronize time since it has sdwdate. How can I synchronize time in the same way non-Kicksecure qubes synchronize their time (.i.e., use ClockVM for Kicksecure qubes instead of sdwdate)?

item.title: Use ClockVM instead of sdwdate
item.dc:creator: moviepuff
item.description:
I’ve figured it out, to use ClockVM instead of sdwdate you have to do the following:

Disable sdwdate and sdwdate-gui (I guess you could also use dummy-dependency but I disabled them instead).

Delete /etc/sdwdate.d/qubes-sync-time-disabled-by-sdwdate.marker file, I put rm -f /etc/sdwdate.d/qubes-sync-time-disabled-by-sdwdate.marker in /rw/config/rc.local in the AppVM so it would get deleted at every AppVM startup in case any updates would recreate the file (you have to do this in every AppVM which is based on the Kicksecure template where you have disabled sdwdate and sdwdate-gui.
